messages:
maria: Trying to kick off prod deploy but deploy-bot returned an access error. Anyone with prod deploy perms online?

deploy-bot: Deployment blocked: service_account "svc-deployer" not in group "prod-deployers". Requestor: @maria. Reason: role_missing.

omar: That svcacct was rotated yesterday, likely lost group binding during rotation. pinging kev_oncall.

kev_oncall: on it. can someone paste the request id from the bot? need to correlate with KMS audit.

maria: request id is rb-1748883333. Also seeing MFA prompt when I try to `gcloud auth login` from the bastion.

sam_security: MFA enforcement for prod deploys rolled out this week — service accounts must get short-lived impersonation tokens via the JIT proxy. Are you using the CI runner or local CLI?

maria: CI runner (github actions). It uses svc-deployer key stored in vault. The key was rotated 07:30 UTC.

julian: CI needs the new impersonation binding. Ops runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-access — section "svcacct rotation". Recommend granting temporary role to `svc-deployer` via IAM binding with expiration.

kev_oncall: I created a temporary binding: `roles/cloudrun.deployer` to svc-deployer expiring in 2h. Logged at KMS audit RB-1748883333. Can someone retry?

maria: retrying now...

deploy-bot: Deployment check passed: svc-deployer now in prod-deployers (via temporary binding). Proceed? Reply with `approve` plus approver handle.

sara: approve — sara (release lead)

deploy-bot: Approval recorded: approver=sara, method=manual-reply. Running `deploy --env=prod --version=v1.4.9`.

maria: started deploy, streaming logs: `rolling update 3/10 pods ready`

oncall-sre: monitoring perf dashboard. Alerting thresholds unchanged.

maria: deploy succeeded — all services healthy. Thanks kev_oncall and sam_security. Note: need to add svc-deployer to rotation checklist to avoid next time.

julian: created follow-up ticket TKT-4521 to update CI runner and add automated binding refresh step.

kev_oncall: leaving note in the rota: remind infra to validate IAM bindings after rotations. :lock:

sam_security: will update the security playbook with the JIT instructions. :white_check_mark:

maria: closing thread. Thanks all. :tada:
